_why: DEFECT-OAG-091 / loop-gate check 8. Declares which local containers belong to ROC and the MAX DISPATCH LIFETIME the reaper derives liveness from. Ownership is provenance (the compose file the container was started from), never a container-name list. Established 2026-08-18 after the loop-gate reported ROC NOT ESTABLISHED — which is not the same as clean: ROC's four emulator containers were undeclared, so an orphan wave would have accumulated unseen. The outage that preceded this left all four Exited(255) for 18h, invisible to any check.
_leaseTtlS: UPDATED 2026-08-19 (DEF-ROC-062): ROC NOW HAS A LEASE WRITER. `make stack-claim PROJECT=ROC` / `.claude/tools/stack-claim.js` write the same `<container>.lease` file this reaper reads, wired automatically into `roc-local-up` (claim on bring-up) and into the gated ROC test targets (`roc-acceptance`, `roc-e2e-battery`, `roc-scenarios` renew on entry — the sign-of-life cadence, mirroring OagEventSource's `ddb-local-assert-ours`) and released by `roc-local-down`. So this value is NO LONGER a substitute for exclusivity protection -- it is now only the GRACE WINDOW for a container that was never claimed at all (started by hand, or a failed lease write), exactly OAG's role for its own leaseTtlS. The previous reasoning (4h because the stack is long-lived across a whole session) is WRONG under the new mechanism: a long-lived, actively-used stack is now protected by its LEASE (renewed on every gated tier), not by outliving an age threshold, so the grace window can and should shrink toward OAG's 1h rather than stay wide to compensate for a missing claim. Kept slightly above OAG's 3600s (not equal) because ROC's cold-start chain (sql-edge -> servicebus-emulator, plus eventhubs-emulator/azurite) is heavier than a single DynamoDB Local container, so an UNCLAIMED-but-genuinely-mid-bringup container gets a little more grace before this age-only fallback would otherwise apply.
_minAgeS: Start/reap race floor: a container this young is immune regardless. The four emulators have a genuine cold-start chain (sql-edge -> servicebus-emulator, plus eventhubs-emulator and azurite), so the floor is above the OAG default to cover the whole chain coming up.
